text: {"lessons":["I enjoyed locking in gains on Stocks A, E, and B, but a realized profit alone does not tell me whether selling was the best decision.","My account value fell after rising, reminding me that short-term moves are uncertain and past price changes do not predict what comes next.","Periods 4 and 5 showed that I do not need to trade every month; I should weigh each decision carefully rather than act just for the satisfaction of trading."]}
